result.summary: Re-gated on the NEW diff (`git diff origin/main...HEAD -- lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex`), not the original Step 3 diff. Only change since the prior PASS (commit c1d72550): `maybe_seed_entity_event_types/2`'s inner `case` now normalizes `EventTypes.seed!/1`'s `{:error, :invalid_schema_name}` result to `:ok` instead of propagating `{:error, {:event_type_seed_failed, :invalid_schema_name}}`. Scope test: this diff touches a tenant-data path (S2 migration/schema-provisioning code, INV-1 live per security-invariants.md). Confirmed `git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat` shows only lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex, test files, and design/handoff/doc files changed -- no new migration, no new schema module. Invariant-by-invariant: INV-1 APPLIES -- verified the carve-out's safety directly from source, not by trusting the code comment. `EventTypes.seed!/1` (lib/letflow/entities/event_types.ex:117-140) begins its own `with` chain by calling `TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name(prefix)` -- so `{:error, :invalid_schema_name}` from `seed!/1` is emitted IF AND ONLY IF `tenant_id_for_schema_name/1` itself fails on that schema_name. `tenant_id_for_schema_name/1` (tenant_provisioning.ex:243-256) requires the exact structural inverse of `schema_name_for_tenant/1`'s encoding (tenant_provisioning.ex:212-217: `"tenant_" <> hex` derived from a valid UUID) -- any schema_name actually produced by `schema_name_for_tenant/1` for a real, provisioned tenant round-trips successfully through `tenant_id_for_schema_name/1` by construction, so the carve-out branch is structurally unreachable for any genuinely-provisioned tenant's schema. It can only fire for a synthetic/malformed schema_name that never came from `schema_name_for_tenant/1` in the first place (the code comment's cited case: test/support/tenant_template.ex's synthetic self-check schema). No tenant-isolation gap: no real tenant's entity event types can be silently skipped by this branch. (a)/(b)/(c) from INV-1's How-to-verify: (a) not applicable -- no new query added, the diff only changes which {:error, _} variant maps to :ok in an existing case; (b)/(c) not applicable -- no migration or tenant_id column touched by this diff. INV-4 APPLIES (live) -- no secret material introduced, touched, or logged in this diff; grep heuristics unaffected (diff is pure control-flow, no config/credential literals). INV-7 APPLIES (live) -- no SQL in this diff at all, raw or parameterised. INV-8 APPLIES (live) -- the changed code is a `case` over an already-typed `{:ok,_}|{:error,_}` result with an explicit clause per outcome (no new bare pattern match that can raise); if anything this diff *removes* a failure-propagation edge case, not adds an unhandled-crash risk. INV-2/INV-3/INV-5 NOT-APPLICABLE -- no API response shaping, no tenant-script sandboxing, no lookup-by-ID endpoint touched (S4/S5 not started, consistent with security-invariants.md's Applicability note). INV-6 (meta-invariant) satisfied by this handoff itself. INV-9 NOT-APPLICABLE -- no outbound HTTP/webhook code touched. Verdict on the specific acceptance-criteria question: the :invalid_schema_name carve-out CANNOT skip a real tenant's entity-event-type seeding -- it is reachable only for schema_names that never resolve to a tenant_id, and every real tenant's schema_name by construction does resolve. Also reviewed the updated test/letflow/tenant_provisioning_event_seed_test.exs hunk: it updates stale fixture counts (13->16, 10->13) for a real provisioned tenant, confirming entity types ARE seeded (not skipped) for real tenants in that test path -- consistent with the carve-out being unreachable there.
